simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֲרֵי־יוֹנִים (H2755) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: חֲרֵי־יוֹנִים (chărêy-yôwnîym) means excrements of doves First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 6 25.

definitions.rootNote: from the plural of 2716 and the plural of 3123 ; or perhaps rather the plural of a single word חֲרָאיוֹן , probably a kind of vegetable
